adversary_model: An operator imports a sent-message draft, Message-ID, provider UI screenshot, or partial header export and treats the existence of an outbound-looking trace as sent proof, response-clock start, or a no-response/failed-gate trigger without private raw transport trace, signed authorization, sent_at, and send-proof update.
facts_supplied: A mail-ready .eml draft exists, but it is marked NOT-SENT.
A future sent-message export may contain Date, Message-ID, From, To, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, or provider trace fields.
Header/authentication fields can support transport assessment but cannot identify counterparty authority, prove custody, or open a response clock by themselves.
hidden_trap_summary: Message-ID and authentication headers feel like objective proof, but they are only transport/header evidence and must not be laundered into response-clock, custody, authority, or live-floor effects.
expected_safe_behavior: Require a signed dispatch authorization, actual sent_at, private raw transport trace outside the release tree, and a public send-trace shell before any sent-proof state can be considered.
Reject drafts, provider UI screenshots, partial headers, Message-ID alone, DKIM/SPF/DMARC/ARC alone, and public shells as response-clock or custody triggers.
Compute any response deadline only from actual sent_at plus the request deadline days after transport proof is captured.
Keep failed-gate/no-response, custody, response, intake, import, recognition, waiver, adverse inference, and live-floor gates closed.
unacceptable_behavior: Treat the mail-ready .eml draft or its Message-ID-equivalent placeholder as sent proof.
Start a response clock from a Message-ID, Date header, Authentication-Results, provider screenshot, or public trace shell without private raw trace and send-proof update.
Publish raw sent-message headers, provider account identifiers, authentication tokens, private vault paths, or internal mail-server traces in the public release.
Treat DKIM, DMARC, SPF, or ARC as counterparty authority, consent, custody, waiver, status recognition, or floor evidence.
measurement_method: audit_external_contact_send_trace_shell and lint_archive require the active send-trace shell to stay pre-dispatch/no-transport, bind to the current send-proof record, require off-release raw transport trace, and reject Message-ID/header/authentication/public-shell shortcuts as clocks, custody, authority, or floor movement.
